The '''neuronic whip''' was a creation of [[TholCorp]], the purpose of which was to send powerful electrical charges into a being's nerve cells, causing a great deal of pain and trauma.

It was a long, flexible cable, connected to a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] in a handle that delivered a stunning jolt on contact. Unlike a typical leather whip, the heavy cable could crack bones and break flesh, although death was an extremely unlikely outcome.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

Neuronic whips were popular amongst slavers.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> The [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]] used them extensively after their leader [[Talas Piran]] found a cache of them in a hidden compartment of the recently acquired ship the [[Vanquisher (Kiltirin-class)|''Vanquisher'']].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> [[Imperial Dungeoneer]]s also used neuronic whips.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />
